value.rationale: The critical SIS reproduction ratio is a natural epidemic bifurcation boundary. This result adds an exact, all-initial-state t^-1 coefficient depending on two behavioral response derivatives, and the simultaneous signed contact relaxation, across all monotone differentiable feedback laws. This is a nontrivial structural characterization beyond a generic exercise or a single model sample.
